Claim 1 (Currently amended): A composition, comprising: cavity-generating particles; a thermally conductive binder selected from the group consisting of a premixed solder paste and a thermally conductive epoxy; and a solvent.

Claim 2 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 1, wherein the composition is applied to an electronic component surface selected from the group consisting of a silicon chip and a microelectronic component.

Claim 3 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 2, wherein the solvent is removed during application to the electronic component surface, wherein the removal occurs by heating the electronic component surface to a temperature sufficient to vaporize the solvent. 

Claim 9 (Currently amended): A composition comprising cavity-generating particles, a binder, and a carrier wherein the particle to binder ratio is about 1 gram to 0.5-0.8 grams and the carrier is about 10 ml per gram of particles, wherein the binder is selected from the group consisting of a premixed solder paste and a thermally conductive epoxy.

Claim 10 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 9, wherein the carrier is selected from the group comprising ethyl alcohol, isopropyl alcohol, acetone, methylethyl ketone, FC-72, or FC-87, and wherein the carrier is present in an amount of about 10 ml per gram of cavity-generating particles.

Claim 12 (Currently amended): The composition of claim 9, wherein the cavity generating particles are selected from the group comprising nickel, copper, aluminum, silver, iron, brass and alloys, and wherein the cavity generating particles are 8-12 microns in size.

Claim 16 (Currently amended): A composition of matter comprising carrier, binder, and cavity generating particles, wherein said composition of matter contains, in relative proportion: about 10 ml carrier; about 0.5 to 0.8 grams binder; and about 1 gram of cavity generating particles, wherein the binder is selected from the group consisting of a premixed solder paste and a thermally conductive epoxy.
